title: Great app
body: I need lists to function but also need them to be simple and effective. This app is perfect. Keeps track by day and you can tick off as you go along. Loving it so far

title: Love this app!!
body:
Really easy to use and keep track of your day/weekly plans. Also helps you with things
Like taking vitamins, and sends you reminders (if you want them) to remind you. 

Great app, 9/10. Love it!

title: Love the app!
body: Great app for tracking habits, very easy to use. LOVE IT. The tasks and recurring events thing is kind of confusing though, its not as good for that purpose, as in is recurring event not the same as habit? I already have a great app for tracking my goals/tasks thats a bit better.
